entities.name: Isobel
entities.description: Angel of Innistrad in the Flight of Alabaster who was driven mad, joined Avacyn's rampage and was slain by humans.

entities.name: Flight of Alabaster
entities.description: Angel flight led by Bruna to which Isobel belonged.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: Angel who led the Flight of Alabaster.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Greatest angel of Innistrad, whose disappearance concerned Isobel and who later led a rampage.

events.summary: Isobel expresses concern over Avacyn's disappearance.
events.quote: Isobel expressed great concern over Avacyn's disappearance

events.summary: Driven to madness, Isobel joins Avacyn's rampage and is slain by humans.
events.quote: was consequently slain by the humans she once protected

relations.quote: a part of The Flight of Alabaster led by Bruna
